lead.event: Bank Central Asia announces its third interim dividend for fiscal 2026
lead.headline: BBCA announces third 2026 interim dividend of Rp4.29 trillion
lead.blurb: Bank Central Asia will pay Rp35 per share. The cum date on regular and negotiation markets is 27 November, the recording date is 1 December and payment is scheduled for 16 December. This is the final interim dividend for fiscal 2026, bringing cumulative interim dividends to Rp80 per share, up 45.5% from the previous fiscal year.

deals_control.event: Abadi Nusantara Hijau Investama postpones its extraordinary shareholders meeting
deals_control.headline: PACK postpones extraordinary shareholders meeting to 8 December
deals_control.blurb: Abadi Nusantara Hijau Investama rescheduled the meeting from 30 November after OJK requested additional information and clarification on its planned business change, material transactions and rights issue. The unchanged agenda includes a rights issue of up to 100 billion new shares worth a maximum Rp8.19 trillion, the acquisition of Bukit Makmur Istindo Nikeltama shares and a planned purchase of Denway Development shares.

earnings_guidance.event: Krakatau Steel reports H1 2026 revenue growth and returns to profit
earnings_guidance.headline: KRAS reports 36.5% H1 revenue growth and returns to profit
earnings_guidance.blurb: Krakatau Steel's revenue reached US$609.21 million, up from US$446.45 million a year earlier. Net profit attributable to owners was US$655,000, reversing a US$107.12 million loss in H1 2025.

earnings_guidance.event: Bumi Resources reports a sharp increase in profit through September 2026
earnings_guidance.headline: BUMI reports 404.9% rise in attributable profit through September
earnings_guidance.blurb: Bumi Resources’ revenue rose 38.85% to US$1.44 billion, while profit for the period increased 190.45% to US$174.56 million, supported by higher volumes, a lower strip ratio and cost efficiency. Shares closed at Rp131 on 26 November, down 68.81% year to date. Mirae Asset assigned an Accumulative Buy recommendation with a Rp222 target price.

earnings_guidance.event: CGS International issues palm-oil sector ratings and a 2027 CPO price forecast
earnings_guidance.headline: CGS International keeps palm-oil sector overweight, sees 2027 CPO at RM4,800 per ton
earnings_guidance.blurb: The broker cites potential supply tightening from El Niño and rising biodiesel demand. Its top pick is Triputra Agro Persada, rated add with a Rp2,700 target, while Astra Agro Lestari and Dharma Satya Nusantara also carry add ratings, with targets of Rp11,000 and Rp2,000, respectively.

earnings_guidance.event: Fortune Indonesia reports higher nine-month revenue after entering coal mining
earnings_guidance.headline: FORU reports higher nine-month revenue of Rp312.31 billion after coal entry
earnings_guidance.blurb: Export coal sales accounted for Rp292.46 billion of Fortune Indonesia's revenue for the nine months ended 30 September, while media income was Rp10.29 billion. Operating expenses of Rp226.75 billion led to a Rp61.71 billion operating loss and an approximately Rp8.2 billion net loss.
